ev.q: During March 2024, seven women experienced illness after receiving botulinum toxin injections in nonmedical settings; four were hospitalized.
All patients sought health care for their illness; four were hospitalized, and two were monitored in intensive care units.
All patients were women, aged 26–55 years (median age = 48 years).
a median of 3 days (range = 2–20 days) before symptom onset.
Characteristics of illnesses after administration of presumed counterfeit botulinum toxin in nonmedical settings

public_health_question.v: What were the characteristics of illnesses after cosmetic injections of presumed counterfeit botulinum toxin in nonmedical settings, and which products were implicated?

ev.q: A multistate investigation, which included the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and CDC, sought to characterize these illnesses and identify implicated BoNT products.
Seven persons experienced illness consistent with local and possible distant spread of BoNT after injection of presumed counterfeit BoNT product
A multistate investigation, which included the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and CDC, sought to characterize these illnesses
NYC DOHMH identified three patients, and TDH identified four (including one Kentucky resident who was admitted to a Tennessee hospital).
Health department staff members interviewed patients and reviewed medical records to obtain information about patients’ signs and symptoms
Tennessee and New York City, March 2024

equity.level_reason: No social-position dimension is analyzed; all patients were women (sex defines the population) and age is only a descriptor.

ev.q: All patients were women, aged 26–55 years (median age = 48 years).

notes: Seven-case series; the table sets Tennessee and NYC columns side by side, but no contrast is drawn, so depth is summary only. Laboratory testing (PCR, mouse bioassay) only sought case confirmation and was negative, so it is not a procedure.
view_issues: Table: first sign diplopia in Tennessee is 1 (100), should be 25%; neck injection total is 3 (43) although Tennessee 0 + NYC 2 = 2; headache/weakness totals 2 (28) vs 2 (29) elsewhere. Title says March 2024; onsets began February 23.
